{{Quote|It's darker than Sarlacc's belly down here.''"<br />"''Turn on your night vision.|dialog aboard the ''Terror'' |<ref name="Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Night vision''' was a type of vision-enhancement technology that allowed one to perceive their surroundings while in complete darkness. Some [[Droid/Legends|droids]], such as the [[G2 repair droid/Legends|G2 repair droid]], were equipped with a component called '''darkvision''', which enabled them to see in the dark.
